problem_statement: sachinchoolur/lightGallery ships a polished Hugo documentation and showcase site (in `site/`) for the lightGallery JavaScript gallery plugin: a fixed Bootstrap navbar (Docs / Demos / License / React / Vue / Angular links), a tall hero thumbnail wall, a trusted-by logo strip, a Modern/Modular/Mobile feature grid, a Super Customizable section, a mixed-contents section, an inline gallery demo, and a shared footer. A visitor who wants to choose a browsing style has no dedicated, interactive place to compare the gallery modes the site already demonstrates. Add a new cross-page 'Gallery Modes' selection page at /gallery-modes/ that reuses the site's own demo thumbnails, captions, and card pattern and presents six gallery-mode cards (image gallery, captioned story, mixed contents, inline gallery, justified gallery, video gallery). Above the card grid, add a native 'Gallery mode focus' filter bar: a row of mode tabs (All modes / Photos / Story / Mixed / Inline / Justified / Video) that filters the grid to the picked mode and drives a live count readout reading 'Showing N of 6 - <mode>'. Register the new page in the shared Hugo menu so a real a.nav-link to /gallery-modes/ renders in the fixed navbar on every page (cross-page consistency). The new page and its filter must feel native to the existing lightGallery visual system (blue/white palette, rounded cards, photo-first composition) and must not replace or hide the existing hero, trusted-by logos, feature grid, super-customizable section, mixed-contents section, inline gallery, or footer. The filter tab row and cards must wrap cleanly and stay legible at tablet and 390px mobile widths without overlap, contrast failure, or horizontal overflow.
required_content: A new /gallery-modes/ page is added that renders inside the shared lightGallery chrome (the same fixed navbar and footer as the rest of the site) rather than as a disconnected standalone page.

The new page presents at least six real gallery styles as cards - image gallery, captioned story, mixed contents, inline gallery, justified gallery, and video gallery - each with a heading, grounded description, and thumbnails drawn from the repo's own demo assets.

Above the card grid the page renders a 'Gallery mode focus' filter bar with a row of mode tabs and a live count readout; picking a mode tab filters the six cards to that mode and updates the readout to read 'Showing N of 6 - <mode>' (for example 'Showing 1 of 6 - Video' after picking Video), while 'All modes' restores all six.

A 'Gallery Modes' entry is registered in the shared navigation menu so an a.nav-link to /gallery-modes/ renders on the homepage and on the new page (cross-page consistency), not only as an in-page anchor.

The new page reuses the site's existing thumbnails, captions, and card/section design language (blue/white spacing, rounded cards, photo-first composition) instead of introducing a different brand, theme, or unrelated media.

The hero thumbnail wall, trusted-by logos, feature grid, super-customizable section, mixed-contents section, inline gallery section, and footer all remain present and recognizable on the homepage after the change.
The filter tab row and the six cards wrap cleanly and stay legible (no overlapping/shingled cards, no low-contrast tab labels) at tablet and 390px mobile widths without horizontal overflow.
Completion signals are visible rendered DOM text and structure (page heading, cards, filter readout, nav-link), not hidden attributes, comments, or screenshot-only changes.
design_constraints: Preserve the existing light-blue and white palette, the rounded content cards, the photo-first composition, and the clean documentation/showcase rhythm.
Do not replace the homepage or the new page with a generic landing page or a different brand; both must remain part of the lightGallery showcase.
Use local and existing repo assets, captions, and demo structures (static/images/demo/*, existing card patterns) as the design source of truth.
Register the new page through the shared Hugo menu system so the nav-link renders consistently on every page, not just via a homepage in-page jump link.

The mode filter must actually re-filter the visible cards and recompute the count readout on every tab pick; the tab row must not overflow, the active tab must stay readable, and the cards must never overlap or shingle at any width.
state_constraints: desktop_home must show the homepage hero thumbnail wall and the existing feature/showcase sections, plus a 'Gallery Modes' nav-link registered in the shared navbar.
tablet_home must preserve the same hero and showcase sections at 834px width with the shared navbar present.
mobile_home must keep the hero and first showcase content readable at 390px width without horizontal overflow (the navbar collapses into the toggler on mobile).

desktop_gallery_modes must render the new /gallery-modes/ page inside the shared navbar and footer chrome, showing the page title, the 'Gallery mode focus' filter bar with tabs and a 'Showing 6 of 6 - All modes' readout, six gallery-mode cards with headings and thumbnails, and the 'Gallery Modes' nav-link.
tablet_gallery_modes must show the filter bar and six gallery-mode cards wrapping cleanly at 834px width.
mobile_gallery_modes must show the filter tab row wrapping and the six cards stacked cleanly with readable headings and thumbnails at 390px width without horizontal overflow.
desktop_gm_video_filter is desktop_gallery_modes after clicking the 'Video' mode tab: the grid filters to the single video card and the readout reads 'Showing 1 of 6 - Video'.

change_completion: The new /gallery-modes/ page exists, renders in the shared site chrome, and helps a visitor compare at least six real gallery styles grounded in the repo's own demos.

The 'Gallery mode focus' filter bar picks a mode, re-filters the visible cards, and recomputes the live 'Showing N of 6 - <mode>' readout; picking Video shows one card and reads 'Showing 1 of 6 - Video'.

The 'Gallery Modes' nav-link is registered in the shared menu and reaches the new page from the homepage and the new page itself; the change is visible in the DOM (page heading, cards, filter readout, nav-link) rather than hidden metadata.
design_consistency: The new page and its filter bar feel native to the existing lightGallery visual system: blue/white spacing, rounded cards and pill tabs, photo-first composition, shared navbar and footer.
The existing homepage sections still read as the same showcase site and are not replaced by a different brand or layout language.
regression: Existing hero gallery, trusted-by logos, feature grid, super-customizable section, mixed-contents section, inline gallery, and footer remain reachable and recognizable.
The new page, filter bar, and nav-link do not obscure or replace the existing homepage sections in desktop, tablet, or mobile captures.
responsive: The filter tab row and the gallery-mode cards remain readable at tablet and 390px mobile widths.
Tabs, cards, thumbnails, and labels wrap cleanly without clipping, overlap, low-contrast labels, or horizontal overflow.

author_notes: Repo-grounded Hugo (site/) Consistency ADD for the lightGallery / lightgallery showcase: a new cross-page /gallery-modes/ selection page built from the site's own demo thumbnails and rounded card design language, with a native 'Gallery mode focus' filter bar (mode tabs + live count readout) above the card grid and a registered shared nav-link. Reference adds the page, the correct mode filter, and the registered nav entry; the baseline keeps the correct filter wiring but ships a pre-fix fixed-width nowrap tab row (mobile overflow), a mobile grid shift, and no registered nav entry; the negative control shingles the cards into an overlapping illegible pile with a near-white-on-near-white active tab, overflows the tab row, drops the nav entry, and freezes the count readout at 'Showing 6 of 6 - All modes' regardless of the picked mode. Product-grade gates: no_horizontal_overflow (tolerance 24), visual_regression (pixelmatch/ssim/block_fidelity over the filter-bar and card image crops), cross-page dom_assertions (a.nav-link plus page structure), interaction_assertions (the mode-filter readout), and enforce_console_errors (max 0). DESIGN_KEYWORDS: gallery, thumbnail, image, photo, card, filter, layout, responsive, mobile, palette.

metadata.selected_repo_reason: lightGallery Hugo docs/showcase site; content_asset_continuity ADD of a new cross-page Gallery Modes selection page with a native mode-focus filter (tabs + live count) over the site's own demo thumbnails and rounded card pattern, plus a registered shared nav-link, maintaining design-system, interaction, and asset consistency across pages.
